parsed.study_design: Operations-research policy case study using historical-data-driven discrete-event simulation, designed experiments, and regression modelling
parsed.population_and_sample: Delaware River reservoir and river-management system; simulations used a 73-year daily inflow history (1928–2000), with some preliminary analyses using 1982–2004 reservoir data
parsed.exposure: Alternative legally and institutionally constrained reservoir-release policies, particularly the adaptive Flexible Flow Management Program
parsed.outcome: Aquatic habitat, drought days, reservoir storage and refill probability, river flows, spill reduction, and flood risk
parsed.rationale: The article evaluates dam-release rules for ecological habitat and regional water-resource management under Supreme Court decrees and interstate governance, rather than household or community water-service access (pp. 18–23, “The Delaware System and Its Water-Allocation Issues”).
